meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Spotlight
meta.description: To welcome freedom is to also welcome death.

units.rawText: There must be a light out there which doesn't hurt.
units.displayText: There must be a light out there which doesn't hurt.

spans.text: There must be a light out there which doesn't hurt.

units.rawText: I will go forth with my limbs and together we will chew everything to bits!
units.displayText: I will go forth with my limbs and together we will chew everything to bits!

spans.text: I will go forth with my limbs and together we will chew everything to bits!

units.rawText: No matter how much it hurts, we have to go into the freedom and light where there is no pain.
units.displayText: No matter how much it hurts, we have to go into the freedom and light where there is no pain.

spans.text: No matter how much it hurts, we have to go into the freedom and light where there is no pain.
